title: About Me
text: I’m a robotics researcher and engineer, currently working for the Boston Dynamics AI Institute where I’m trying to make robots learn to do stuff by watching humans do said stuff. Previously, I spent time at Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute where I made robots move around while looking at the right things around them. Eons ago, I studied electrical systems and computer science at the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani.
